QUOTE: `detokenize` (lines 86-105) makes a second `llama_token_to_piece` call only when the 256-byte stack buffer is too small. That is size-on-demand, and it is still not retry.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says detokenize uses a 256-byte stack buffer and makes a second call only when it is too small, while tokenize always makes two calls to size first.
